title: Sustainability Manager
description:
General Description:

The Sustainability Manager will be responsible for driving the company’s sustainability strategy with a strong focus on Scope 3 emissions. This role will identify and mitigate sustainability risks, embed sustainable practices into procurement and supply chain operations, manage sustainability data and reporting, and communicate progress transparently to internal and external stakeholders. The role will report to the Head of Procurement & Sustainability Excellence.

Essential Functions:

  • Develop, implement, and monitor the company’s sustainability strategy with emphasis on Scope 3 emissions reduction, ensuring alignment with corporate goals and values.
  • Manage sustainability budgets, including projects and future financial projections through 2027.
  • Identify, assess, and prioritize sustainability risks and opportunities across the value chain; maintain and update climate risk mapping (e.g., Power BI dashboards based on BSI data).
  • Integrate climate-related risks into enterprise risk management (ERM) systems and mitigation plans, and ensure effective tracking and follow-up.
  • Establish and maintain accurate Scope 3 data tables, target-setting frameworks, and emissions footprint repositories.
  • Track and report supplier sustainability data to meet internal needs and external obligations (e.g., sustainability reports, Hong Kong Stock Exchange requirements).
  • Collaborate with sourcing managers (primarily direct, with some indirect) to embed Scope 3 reduction into category strategies, sourcing decisions, and implementation plans.
  • Develop and implement sustainable procurement policies, including ESG sourcing guidance, supplier evaluation criteria, and performance measurement.
  • Lead supplier engagement initiatives, including climate questionnaires, maturity assessments, outreach, and training sessions, to improve supplier performance on sustainability.
  • Support supplier development programs, including diversity, audits, partnerships, and capability-building initiatives.
  • Educate suppliers and third-party vendors on climate awareness and emissions reduction expectations.
  • Research and evaluate new sustainability technologies and trends (e.g., AI resource use, green chemistry, sustainable construction, and packaging) for business impact and adoption potential.
  • Provide regular updates and reports to procurement leadership and other stakeholders (e.g., PLT updates, ESG sourcing guidance, sustainability reports).
  • Design and deliver internal sustainability education and awareness programs, including recorded webinars and training for procurement teams.
  • Ensure compliance with evolving regulations, industry best practices, and responsible procurement due diligence requirements.
  • Build business cases for sustainability initiatives, drive organizational change, and act as a trusted advisor on sustainable business practices.

Minimum Requirements – Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sustainability management, with proven expertise in Scope 3 emissions.

Other Experience:

  • Strong understanding of sustainability and ESG principles, with practical application in procurement and supply chain.
  • Experience developing and implementing supplier engagement and responsible procurement programs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with ability to build compelling business cases.
  • Excellent project management, organizational, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive change without direct authority.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience preparing clear reports and presentations for diverse audiences.
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or a related regulated sector is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaboration across teams.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

N/A

Travel:

Approximately 10%

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com bibliotecas de IA generativa open source (Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, Llama Index).
  • Conhecimento de MLOps (MLFlow Registry, TFX, CI/CD para modelos).
  • Implementação de pipelines de dados/ML em Airflow ou Composer.
  • Participação em competições de ciência de dados ou publicações técnicas.
  • Noções de IA generativa multimodal (texto + imagem ou visão computacional).

Sophos is a global leader and innovator of advanced security solutions for defeating cyberattacks. The company acquired Secureworks in February 2025, bringing together two pioneers that have redefined the cybersecurity industry with their innovative, native AI-optimized services, technologies and products. Sophos is now the largest pure-play Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider, supporting more than 28,000 organizations. In addition to MDR and other services, Sophos’ complete portfolio includes industry-leading endpoint, network, email, and cloud security that interoperate and adapt to defend through the Sophos Central platform. Secureworks provides the innovative, market-leading Taegis XDR/MDR, identity threat detection and response (ITDR), next-gen SIEM capabilities, managed risk, and a comprehensive set of advisory services. Sophos sells all these solutions through reseller partners, Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) worldwide, defending more than 600,000 organizations worldwide from phishing, ransomware, data theft, other everyday and state-sponsored cybercrimes. The solutions are powered by historical and real-time threat intelligence from Sophos X-Ops and the newly added Counter Threat Unit (CTU). Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at

Role Summary

The Channel Account Executive (CAE) is accountable for managing strategic Sophos partners. They are responsible for developing joint business plans with partners to hit revenue and profitability targets by developing new MDR, services, MSP, and next-gen portfolio customer opportunities, up-sell, and cross-selling to existing customers and renewals.

What You Will Do

  • Develop relationships at all levels across the partner to drive revenue growth and profitability; particularly for mid-market customers, MSP, and Managed, Detection and Response (MDR)
  • Build and execute business plans that identify, develop, and close incremental opportunities to deliver outstanding growth for the partner and Sophos.

  • Coordinate the involvement of Sophos staff, including product management, sales, SE, marketing, support, service, and management resources to meet partner performance objectives and partner expectations.

  • Ensure the Sophos Sales Centre of Excellence is proactively engaged to manage processes to progress and close of sub-100 user opportunities.
  • Motivate, educate, and ensure Partner sales and technical staff are go-to-market ready, provide access to certification and training materials and develop an enablement plan.

  • 3-5 years of channel sales and territory management in networking or security sectors
  • Experience building successful business and marketing plans
  • Understanding of the technology channel eco-system and the business model of different types of channel partners (VAR/MSP etc.)
  • Adept at account management and business partner techniques with strong interpersonal, active listening, discovery, and qualification skills

title: Team Lead
description:
Overview

Sunbit builds financial technology for real life. Our technology eases the stress of paying for life’s expenses by giving people more options on how and when they pay. Founded in 2016, Sunbit offers a next-generation, no-fee credit card that can be managed through a powerful mobile app, as well as a point-of-sale payment option available at more than 25,000 service locations, including auto dealership service centers, optical practices, dental offices, veterinary clinics, and specialty healthcare services. Sunbit was included on the 2022 Inc. 5000 list. The financial technology company has also been named Sunbit as a Most Loved Workplace, Best Point of Sale Company, and a Top Fintech Startup by CB Insights.

We use cutting-edge innovations in financial technology to bring leading data and features that allow individuals to be qualified instantly, making purchases at the point-of-sale fast, fair, and easy for consumers from all walks of life. We create value focused on our core values; we work tirelessly to ensure that Sunbit becomes available to everyone, everywhere.

We invite you to #UnleashyourCuriosity and join our ever-growing R&D organization.

What You’ll Do

As the Team Lead of the Account Management squad , you will guide a multidisciplinary team of backend and data engineers responsible for some of Sunbit’s most critical financial operations. Your mission is to build and scale the systems that keep our loan and card processes accurate, transparent, and resilient — while fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and technical excellence within the squad.

In this role, you’ll not only manage talented engineers but also work closely with finance, risk, product, and compliance stakeholders to ensure our technology delivers real business impact. Your team’s scope includes payment allocation, disbursement management, and the delivery of loan and card performance data products that support both internal decision-making and external reporting across regulators, partners, and investors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing squad of backend and data engineers.
  • Own and evolve Sunbit’s loan account management systems and data products.
  • Ensure accuracy and automation in payment allocation and manage disbursement flows.
  • Deliver high-quality Loan Performance and Card Performance data products used across internal operations, executive dashboards, and external reporting.
  • Build scalable, reliable systems that support high transaction volumes with full financial integrity.
  • Partner with finance, risk, product, and compliance to align technology with business goals.

Requirements

  • B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 10+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on software system architecture.
  • 4+ years of experience leading engineering teams and managing end-to-end project lifecycles.
  • Strong background in building large-scale, high-performance financial or transactional systems.
  • Experience with data pipelines, big data infrastructure, microservices architecture, and message bus.
  • Hands-on experience with Java and Python, and modern cloud technologies.
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across engineering, finance, risk, and product stakeholders.
  • Adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English.

Advantages

  • Working knowledge of Kotlin.
  • Prior experience in fintech or payment systems.
  • Familiarity with loan and card performance data products and internal/external reporting use cases.

Why Join Us

Join Sunbit at the core of our financial operations, leading the squad that ensures loan and card performance data products, disbursement management, and payment allocation systems are accurate, resilient, and scalable. Your leadership will shape both the technology and the people who build it, powering Sunbit’s growth and setting the standard for modern financial operations.

title: UX Designer - Remote - Brazil
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a UX Designer (Remote) candidate that resides in Brazil.

The UX Designer will play a key role in delivering high-quality, user-focused design solutions that support sales, marketing, and purchasing initiatives. This position is responsible for creating intuitive, engaging digital experiences and contributing visually compelling assets that align with brand objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in UX principles and visual design, leveraging user research, wireframes, and prototyping to improve interfaces and optimize user journeys. They will collaborate across departments to deliver purposeful, innovative design solutions that elevate both function and form reporting to the Creative Director.

Important: While this role is open to candidates across any location in Brazil, High Tide brands do not operate or market in Brazil. This role will support our global markets in North America and Europe.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the creation of user-centered, visually engaging design strategies that enhance customer engagement and brand connection across digital platforms.
  • Translate complex concepts into clean, elegant user experiences through intuitive flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, and competitive audits to uncover insights that inform visual design decisions.
  • Design user journeys, personas, and sitemaps that bring clarity and intention to navigation and structure.
  • Apply responsive and accessible design principles to ensure seamless experiences across all devices and audiences.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure design intent is maintained in final implementation—no coding is required.
  • Use design analytics tools (e.g., Hotjar, Google Analytics) to evaluate user engagement and optimize visual UX outcomes.
  • Stay current with design trends, emerging tools, and UX best practices to continuously elevate digital design standards.

Web Design Responsibilities

  • Design aesthetically refined, responsive websites and digital experiences that reflect brand identity and drive user engagement.
  • Craft visually dynamic layouts, landing pages, and UI components with a focus on clarity, hierarchy, and storytelling.
  • Work closely with marketing, e-commerce, and content teams to align design with strategic goals, user needs, and brand tone.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and brand style guides to ensure consistency and scalability across all touchpoints.
  • Design complementary digital assets such as banners, email templates, promotional graphics, and pop-ups that support campaign objectives.
  • Provide design QA during handoff and development phases to uphold visual quality and ensure design consistency.

Organizational & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Contribute to a creative and collaborative team environment by participating in critiques, brainstorming sessions, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Manage multiple design projects with efficiency, consistently meeting deadlines while maintaining attention to visual and UX detail.
  • Maintain organized, well-labeled design files and ensure work is version-controlled and accessible across shared platforms.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

Education:

  • 3 – 4-year Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, or a related visual design discipline.

Skills & Experience:

  • 3 – 5 years of experience in UX and visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing modern, clean, and user-focused work across web, mobile, and email.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), Figma, and Mac-based design workflows.
  • Expertise in user experience design principles, user interface best practices, and visual storytelling across digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with email marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo) and design standards for high-performance email campaigns.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present design concepts and rationale to diverse stakeholders.
  • Collaborative spirit, visual creativity, and a passion for delivering design that delights users and drives results.

Why Join High Tide

  • Be part of one of the largest global cannabis and accessories companies.
  • Join a collaborative, team that values speed, ownership, and creativity.
  • Fully remote role with flexibility and meaningful impact.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit:

  • Yourresume in English.
  • (Optional) Any relevant portfolio or example campaigns that reflect your expertise and experience.

High Tide Inc. is the leading community-grown, retail-forward cannabis enterprise engineered to unleash the full value of the world’s most powerful plant and is the second-largest cannabis retailer globally by store count⁷ . Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.

  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

Com mais de 85 anos de existência, o Instituto Brasil-Estados Unidos já impactou a vida de milhares de pessoas por meio do ensino de idiomas. Somos um centro bi-nacional reconhecido pela Embaixada e Consulados Americanos, e preparamos os nossos estudantes para as certificações internacionais e para um futuro sem fronteiras.

Tradição, dedicação e excelência estão em nosso DNA!Somos um time de profissionais apaixonados por educação, movidos pelo sonho de transformar a realidade do Brasil por meio do ensino bilíngue.

Cultura é um pilar essencial aqui no Ibeu! Desde a nossa fundação, nos dedicamos ao incentivo às manifestações artísticas. Overview

Company Overview

Dadosfera is transforming the data landscape with a platform that delivers advanced Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities—previously available only to tech giants like Meta, Amazon, Alphabet, and Microsoft—into the hands of small and medium-sized businesses. By democratizing access to these technologies, we empower our clients to accelerate business opportunities through AI-powered Data Apps.

Our platform minimizes the time spent on cloud management and streamlines the entire data lifecycle—from collection and exploration to processing and interaction—allowing clients to focus on their business goals. Built on a high-growth SaaS model, Dadosfera offers tailored solutions that meet real business needs.

What sets Dadosfera apart is our innovative focus on speed, scalability, and flexibility, combining big data storage with advanced analytics to drive strategic decision-making. Leveraging years of experience with data platform implementations on foreign public clouds, we now deliver a cost-effective, locally adapted solution tailored for both Brazilian and global markets. By blending deep expertise with localized infrastructure, Dadosfera provides a powerful, efficient tool that optimizes corporate data management and drives data-driven transformation.

About the Job

As a Data Analyst – BI & Data Modeling , you will play a key role in structuring data models, building impactful dashboards, and supporting decision-making across multiple areas of the company. You will be responsible for organizing and transforming data into clear, actionable insights, while ensuring quality, consistency, and governance throughout the entire process.

Responsibilities

  • Translate business rules implemented in ABAP (SAP) into SQL.
  • Design and maintain “golden” tables, ensuring consistency and reliability of data.
  • Develop and maintain data models to support business analysis and strategic reporting.
  • Build, optimize, and document ETL/ELT processes.
  • Create dashboards and reports in BI tools for different business areas.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, product, business) to translate needs into analytical solutions.
  • Support the definition and monitoring of KPIs and business metrics.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven experience in data analysis and data modeling.
  • Proficiency in BI tools (preferably Tableau).
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to translate business rules into complex queries.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT processes.
  • Analytical mindset, proactive attitude, and initiative to structure and lead BI and data modeling initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of SAP/ABAP to interpret and translate business rules.
  • Experience with cloud databases (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake).
  • Knowledge of Python or R for advanced analytics.
  • Experience defining and monitoring strategic business metrics.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Basic to intermediate Spanish proficiency.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS

Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you\'ll do

The Associate Technical Course Developer uses curriculum, lab, and video development processes to support the development of materials to be used in a variety of training delivery methods, including instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, self-paced, video, and blended training solutions. This position will focus on the full Docusign product suite including our IAM, eSignature, and CLM curricula. You will review and test training for a variety of roles including product administrators, end users, implementers, workflow developers, architects, API developers, and AI specialists. You should be comfortable taking direction from management and senior course developers to support all levels of technical audiences and working with content that is translated into multiple languages. The Associate Technical Course Developer learns and follows defined development processes, uses development tools to complete tasks, updates training materials for existing classroom and online courses, tests and troubleshoots course activities, and contributes to the evolution of our course development processes.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Technical Course Development.

Responsibility

  • Review and test the course and lab content for all Docusign product training courses and videos

  • Perform course content conversions and migrations across tools and/or templates
  • Build and configure exam content in standard tools and templates
  • Maintain translated course materials for localized content including product specific image captures in multiple languages
  • Collaborate with colleagues and technical subject matter experts when appropriate to assist in the maintenance of accurate, effective, and timely curriculum that supports internal and external needs
  • Implement feedback received from standard sources: management, senior course developers, or technical subject matter experts

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como ENFERMEIRO NEONATAL que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha uma atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Participar e dar continuidade às atividades executadas pela Gerência e Coordenação de Enfermagem;
  • Respeitar hierarquia do Organograma da Enfermagem e instituição;
  • Exercer a função assistencial e administrativa, educativa, de pesquisa e social em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem;
  • Participar das reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, Comissão Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes (CIPA), Comissão de Controle de Infecções Hospitalares (CCIH), Serviço de Educação Continuada e demais comissões instituídas na empresa/instituição;
  • Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e os que dificultam o processo de enfermagem;
  • Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor buscando o bem-estar da equipe interdisciplinar;
  • Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente;
  • Atender as necessidades da sua equipe de enfermagem orientando-os e supervisionando, e dos pacientes, priorizando pelo grau de dependência;
  • Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo as da CCIH, de acordo com os POPs;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão leito a leito, passando ou recebendo os pacientes, com os prontuários em ordem: impressos identificados, medicação verificada, artigos com data de trocas em dia, exames realizados e anotações claras, conferência de materiais do setor e expurgo limpo e organizado;
  • Realizar a cada plantão, registro no Livro de Ordens e Ocorrências, descrevendo o quantitativo de equipe presente, preenchendo o checklist (materiais permanentes e controle de pacientes), anotando as intercorrências e informações relevantes;
  • Assegurar as conformidades quanto às metas planejadas pelo Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente (NSP);
  • Identificar as não conformidades e garantir a abertura das Notificações do NSP;
  • Realizar a admissão do paciente e evolução diária, preenchendo corretamente o impresso de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem (SAE);
  • Realizar visitas aos pacientes em todo plantão, priorizando pelo seu grau de dependência, avaliando-os através de exame físico e observação constante, anotando na SAE e garantindo a qualidade da assistência prestada;
  • Avaliar os pacientes utilizando os indicadores adotados pela instituição (Braden Q e Escala Hupty Dumpty);
  • Encaminhar corretamente o paciente ao Centro Cirúrgico e preencher o impresso de Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem Perioperatória (SAEP);
  • Certificar o uso correto da pulseira de identificação e realizar corretamente a identificação do paciente;
  • Carimbar e assinar qualquer evolução e/ou registro realizado, na ausência do carimbo, escrever o nome todo por extenso com o número do Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN);
  • Assistir ao paciente diretamente, principalmente os mais graves, atendendo a todas as suas necessidades básicas afetadas, promovendo condições adequadas para seu repouso e recuperação;
  • Realizar os procedimentos técnicos de maior complexidade, de competência do enfermeiro, como os curativos com drenos ou infectados, curativos de úlcera por pressão (preenchendo o controle de feridas), curativos de acesso profundo, cateterismos vesical, sondagem vesical, nasogástrica e nasoentérico, não podendo ser delegado aos técnicos, lembrando-se de registrar tudo corretamente na evolução do paciente;
  • Aprazar a prescrição médica, obedecendo à padronização determinada, observando que sejam obedecidos todos os cuidados;
  • Preparar e instalar os drippings dos pacientes, delegando essa função à equipe técnica somente na presença de eventualidades;
  • Encaminhar aos setores responsáveis, pedido de exames e autorização de materiais especiais, devidamente protocolados;
  • Informar ao médico assistente, as intercorrências que venham a ocorrer com o paciente ou com a terapêutica adotada;

  • 1 ano de experiência na função
  • Conhecimento de protocolos e normas, ética, procedimentos específicos do setor, picc

Position Summary

Plug Power Inc. is committed to providing best-in-class technical support for our products to our global customer base on a 24/7 basis. The Technical Support Specialist is a subject matter expert for troubleshooting and maintenance of Plug Power’s products – Electrolyzer, Hydrogen Storage & Dispensing Infrastructure and Stationary/Motive Fuel Cell Systems. Responsibilities include monitoring system performance via SCADA, handling support tickets and customer calls within the established product support environment and resolving issues with fielded systems. The specialist develops and maintains technical product knowledge documents to provide world-class technical support to customers and field personnel servicing Plug products. The ideal candidate possesses a broad range of technical knowledge related to Plug Power’s product lines and can transfer that knowledge to others with varying levels of skill and experience.

Note: This section preserves the original information without altering meaning.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support by assisting customers and Plug field personnel in researching, diagnosing, troubleshooting and identifying solutions to repair hydrogen infrastructure systems.
  • Prioritize support requests by severity and customer impact and drive resolution of field issues with expected urgency. Escalate matters when required to ensure proper attention is given to critical situations.
  • Investigate failure incident root cause and support problem resolution.
  • Drive improvement of Plug infrastructure products by initiating, testing and verifying hardware, software and document changes (e.g., service bulletins, procedures, parts lists).
  • Build and maintain technical knowledge for all Plug Electrolyzer, Hydrogen Storage & Dispensing and Fuel Cell Systems through training, documentation review and applied field experience.
  • Operate infrastructure equipment remotely and on-site at customer and internal test facilities.
  • Ensure accurate, clear, high-quality and complete information is documented in support tickets, solution articles and fault-handling procedures.
  • Communicate and implement improvements to the technical support process, digital platforms and tools to drive a world-class support offering to external and internal customers.
  • Support new site installations as needed; help to provide end-user technical instruction.
  • Improve procedures and training materials for end customers and field service technicians.
  • Travel to customer locations to perform technical functions including troubleshooting and repair; author incident reports commensurate with technical repairs.
  • Build effective internal relationships with colleagues around the world; work cross-functionally as needed for project assignments.
  • Partner with engineering, operations and other internal teams to communicate relevant technical issues, helping to make design and operational improvements across the business.
  • Be available to work a variety of shifts or times. This is a 24-hour, 7-days/week operation.

Education and Experience

Position Purpose

A Home Depot Installation Services (HDIS) Design Consultant is responsible for selling the Company's exterior and interior product and services to customers. The Design Consultant's primary responsibility is outside sales visits to customer homes and trade shows. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Design Consultant will spend the majority of his or her working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Design Consultants will travel to customer's homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations, develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs and maintain/drive profitability. The Design Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Design Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). To drive sales and increase the pipeline of potential customers, a Design Consultant will travel to their assigned stores, maintain local relationships, educate store associates on HDIS offerings, and bring awareness to HDIS programs.

Proactively seek out new referrals and develop and maintain relationships with store management and associates. title: Senior Analyst, Climate Finance
description:
About CPI

Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change. CPI has seven offices around the world in Brazil, India, Indonesia, South Africa, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

Climate Finance Tracking

Since 2011, CPI has published the Global Landscape of Climate Finance series which has been the global benchmark for robust information on climate finance, providing foundational data for the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change 6th Assessment Report, and the UNFCCC’s Biennial Assessment among others. CPI also develops deep dive analysis tracking climate finance flows at sectoral, national and regional levels including the intersection of climate and SDG goals, agrifood systems finance, adaptation and renewable energy working with partners such as the Global Center on Adaptation (GCA), International Development Finance Club (IDFC), the Glasgow Financial Alliance for Net Zero, Bloomberg, the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) and many more.

Our unique tracking analysis covers both public and private finance data, providing access through concise reporting and interactive data visualization. Our research provides a baseline and compelling analysis against which to measure progress. This enables us to drive informed climate finance policymaking through three key levers:

  • Flows – what investment is flowing to whom
  • Needs – what is the investment gap to deliver on climate goals
  • Impact – what is proving effective and efficient in climate finance

Position Summary

This position supports the delivery of key objectives across CPI’s strategic priorities, under the supervision and guidance of Brazil's Research Director. CPI offers a challenging environment that requires independent thinking, collaboration, and pragmatic problem solving. This Senior Analyst role will be focused within the CPI’s Climate Finance Tracking workstream, including tracking national climate finance flows, aligning finance with low-carbon and climate-resilient development, and assessing key gaps in financing climate action at regional and sectoral levels as well as managing relationships with partners and key stakeholders.

Senior Analysts undertake robust and careful analysis, drawing on methodologies from micro- and macroeconomics, public policy, regulatory economics, finance, behavioural science, risk management, statistics, law, engineering, and other disciplines. In conducting analysis, Senior Analysts work in close cooperation, often leading, a range of partners from the policy, finance, and corporate spheres, as well as with CPI teams across the globe.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Perform rigorous quantitative and qualitative evaluation of national and international climate finance mechanisms and climate and energy policies, risk management, and interactions between public and private actors and resources
  • Lead/Manage climate finance tracking projects as designated by, and under the direction of senior management, develop, manage, and implement complex research assignments and analytical projects
  • Lead the writing and editing of high-quality CPI products, including full reports, executive summaries, blogs, and presentations. Produce high-quality materials that are fit for purpose time and within budget
  • Identify opportunities to develop and consolidate work streams and lead development of funding proposals under guidance of senior management
  • Train, manage and provide guidance to junior staff on professional work practices and lead by example
  • Engage clients, advise policymakers and investors on the implications of research findings
  • Communicate and collaborate with CPI staff working around the globe

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Essential:

  • Post-graduate or master's degree with 5-7 years in Economics, Finance, Investment or another relevant field
  • Significant professional experience in financial services, management consulting, international nonprofit, government, and/or a multilateral institution
  • Strong understanding of climate finance and the financial sector actors and actions that are needed to mobilize effective finance towards adaptation and resilience activities
  • Excellent project management skills including time management, task delegation and prioritization, and communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage and engage stakeholders in the financial sector
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English

Beneficial:

  • Significant experience in research and analysis related to climate/green finance; experience across the public and private sectors in climate/green investments, taxonomies, net zero finance
  • Advanced user of MS Office, particularly Excel; knowledge of SQL, R, Python is a plus
  • Sector-specific or multi-sector climate finance expertise
  • Willingness to travel

Personal Attributes:

  • Independent, analytical mind with an excellent track record of applying sound financial, political, and strategic judgment to complex issues
  • Proven leadership skills, willingness and ambition to take initiative
  • Strong commitment to topics related to climate change and a desire to make a difference
  • Flexibility, professionalism, enthusiasm for team work, and ability to interact with diverse people; strong attention to detail, organization, time management, prioritization, and ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills

Position details

CPI is recruiting for a full-time position in our Rio de Janeiro office. CPI in Brazil hires through the Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio) with a “CLT” contract. CPI has adopted a hybrid working policy whereby staff mix remote work with 2 regular days in the Rio de Janeiro office in Gávea.

CPI offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes 20 days leave, office closure between Christmas and New Year, 5 days study leave, USD 500 professional development budget and possibility to enrol on PUC’s courses.

Salaries are based on experience and market.

To apply

To apply, please submit a current resume and answer all the following questions in English, by October 5th. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Please add to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us.

CPI Commitment

Climate Policy Initiative is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion and we are working to embed DEI across every facet of our organisation. We seek to establish a working environment where all board members, staff, volunteers, and contractors feel respected and valued regardless of gender, age, race, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation or identity, disability, education, or any other bias. We want to create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity are openly valued as critical to the success of our organization and the achievement of our mission and vision.

If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history —and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a skilled and driven Senior Application Security Engineer to join Rain’s growing Security team. This role demands a proactive approach to secure software development and cloud-native defense. You will partner closely with engineering and development squads, and work alongside our Cloud Security and GRC team members to improve Rain’s application and platform security posture.

This position is technically grounded, requiring direct engagement in application-layer matters and security reviews, while also contributing to cloud security automation, awareness initiatives, and secure engineering practices across the SDLC.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with development squads to validate vulnerabilities and provide actionable remediation guidance aligned with business risk.
  • Drive threat modeling sessions (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA) for critical systems and APIs.
  • Design, implement, and oversee automated processes for securely updating application and code dependencies, proactively mitigating issues and ensuring timely vulnerability remediation.
  • Integrate security checks into CI / CD pipelines (SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC), working with tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Trivy, and Burp Suite.
  • Contribute to runtime security initiatives, such as container / Kubernetes hardening, RASP, and eBPF-based detection.
  • Build and maintain a security issues dashboard to track remediation status and metrics.
  • Provide real-time support in the event of cybersecurity incidents impacting applications or cloud infrastructure (exploited vuln, credential stuffing, web / API attacks).
  • Partner with the Cloud Security team on security automation tasks and monitoring improvements (e.g., Security Hub remediation automations, DLP monitoring, etc.).
  • Conduct proactive research on new threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques relevant to Rain’s architecture.
  • Collaborate with the GRC team to develop and deliver internal security awareness initiatives, phishing campaigns, and developer training (e.g., secure coding, API security).
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of AppSec maturity (e.g., aligning with OWASP SAMM, ISO 27001, or SOC 2 frameworks).

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent English, including strong verbal and written skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey security risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing roles, and/or secure code development, including work with QA teams.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., Semgrep, Burp, Snyk).
  • Deep understanding of web, mobile, and API vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, MITRE CWE).
  • Proven expertise in performing code review or security assessments and writing clear reports.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g., Go, Python, Node.js) and understanding of React / React Native front-ends.
  • Familiarity with secure architecture of microservices, event-driven systems, and REST APIs using OAuth2 / OpenID Connect.
  • Experience securing CI / CD pipelines and integrating AppSec tooling into SDLC.
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM principles, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and working within cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CPTE, or CSSLP.
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification.
  • Familiarity with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBPF runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM / AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

Who We Are

Rain is filled with people with a deeply rooted passion for our mission, who embrace diversity throughout our global team, and grow personally and professionally. We own what we do and let data guide our actions while working quickly and adapting to new challenges everyday.

title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure & Security
description:
Are you a product-focused engineering leader passionate about hiring and scaling high performance teams? Do you consider yourself a skilled and empathic manager? Do you enjoy leading people, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and improving software development practices? Have you mentored, coached and provided a clear framework for growth for your team members? We might have the perfect opportunity for you.

Overview

ABOUT US:

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

We support over 20,000 restaurants across North America , helping process $1B+ in gross food sales while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees . Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash.

Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni . As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

About the Position:

ChowNow’s Engineering Team has built a modern platform to enable restaurants to streamline their online ordering processes and create a strong digital brand. Our “quality product first” approach to engineering contributes to our success and brand recognition. We’ve reached the time when we need to grow and scale our engineering team to meet the demand of the many exciting new products and features on our roadmap.

We’re looking for an experienced software engineering leader to join our growing engineering team. As an Engineering Manager, you will help us launch reliable and stable products and support new initiatives to continuously improve the experience of our users. You will shape the product, the software architecture, the development process, and the culture.

Most importantly, you will motivate, encourage and lead your team to success, by finding growth opportunities, providing constructive feedback, and combining challenge and support to get the best out of your colleagues. You will be vital in fostering an engineering culture based on collaboration, inclusion, support, measuring and tracking results, and constant improvement.

This position will lead a team of DevOps and Security Engineers who are focused on building the systems that will fuel our future key strategies. Your team will directly influence new features while simultaneously tackling engineering-driven initiatives to support our efforts to scale.

This role reports to the Chief Technology & Product Officer. Manages a team of 5 engineers.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note: ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

What We Love About You

You put restaurants first. You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.

You celebrate diversity. You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are. You have an ability to listen to other team members\' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.

You raise your hand. You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.

You keep reaching. You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

What Success Looks Like

Within 30 Days You’ll:

  • Complete our ChowNow onboarding (Ramp Camp) where you’ll learn the ins and outs about ChowNow and our products.
  • Get to know people - your direct team of DevOps and security Engineers as well as the rest of the Engineering organization, Product, and Design.
  • Join team stand-ups, sprint planning, and more in order to get familiar with the overall product and team processes.
  • Familiarize yourself with the end to end development process and SDLC.
  • Spend deep dive time with the team to learn more about the core products and how they all fit together.
  • Through 1:1s and team sessions, start to understand your team members’ areas of strength and opportunity, in order to be able to provide career guidance and performance reviews.
  • Understand how business goals and compliance affect our internal processes.

Within 60 Days You’ll:

  • Build a deep technology roadmap with strong emphasis on infrastructure as code, security and release engineering
  • Coach your team on building and delivering new features and capabilities to support our production applications
  • Develop strong relationships with Engineering Leadership and Product peers.
  • Review product requirements and design documents, perform code reviews and weigh in on implementation choices.

Within 90 Days You’ll:

  • Collaborate on defining high-level technology roadmap addressing tech debt, product roadmap, and other needs.
  • Provide on-going constructive feedback and guidance to your team members and as part of performance reviews.
  • Support and collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent application of engineering practices.
  • Lead the evolution of software development processes and practices supporting growth of the team and new product initiatives.

You Should Apply If You

  • You have at least 7 years of experience in DevOps and cloud infrastructure engineering, with at least 3 to 5 years in an engineering manager position. This experience should include building, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams.
  • You have deep, hands-on expertise with building and managing AWS or GCP based cloud-native infrastructures to run micro-services based, mission-critical SaaS applications, including their security features, services, and core components
  • You have proficiency with Infrastructure as code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or AWS CloudFormation to automate the deployment and management of cloud resources.
  • You have strong knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, along with managing service mesh such as Linkerd or Istio.
  • You are passionate about Observability, APM, and have experience with DataDog or equivalent technologies
  • You have experience with CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment) pipelines using GitHub Actions or Jenkins, along with integrating security practices throughout the lifecycle
  • You have experience in driving towards and maintaining compliance such as PCI-DSS, SOC2, etc.
  • You have a strong understanding of cloud data warehouses, Snowflake is a plus. Experience in the MLOps is a plus.
  • You have experience with incident response planning, threat detection, and forensics within cloud environments.
  • You have a passion for team building and a track record of recruiting, onboarding and fostering high-performing engineering teams.
  • You care about the quality of work your team produces.
  • You are a fan of rapid iteration and experimentation. You think about failures as a learning opportunity.
  • You are a thoughtful mentor and leader who loves supporting your team and collaborating with others to achieve great things.
  • You thrive in environments supporting your growth, and where you can support others.
  • You are passionate with a contagious energy, encouraging those around you to pursue their goals.

About Our Benefits

  • Expected Base Salary Range: $201,875 - $262,500 depending on candidate location
  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities.
  • A "Best Place to Work" winner multiple times where we focus on creating a great employee experience.
  • Rock solid medical, dental, and vision plans.
  • Mental Health Coverage - we offer several programs to support your mental health and wellness goals.
  • Unlimited Paid Vacation. We expect you to work hard, but still enjoy your personal life
  • 7 weeks of baby bonding time for all new parents (within the first year of birth or adoption), 8 Weeks of Paid Pregnancy Leave.
  • 401(k) Matching
  • Employer-contributing student loan assistance program or continuing education reimbursement program
  • Commuter benefits (including Uber Pool).
  • Employee Stock Incentive Plan.
  • Pet insurance for your fur babies
  • Consistent & fair leadership: we’ll share info, set clear goals, show you respect, and treat everyone fairly.
  • Enough freedom to spread your wings while still holding you accountable.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.

Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura :

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It : Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride : Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit : Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play : Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason : O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é ser uma pessoa Sênior SWE

Como Sênior SWE Web esperamos que possa ter grande influência técnica no time, com o papel de compartilhar conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, familiarizado(a) com testes unitários, automatizados, e oferecendo suporte às pessoas desenvolvedoras do time. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Irá apoiar na evolução da régua técnica do time, será "hands on" que precisará mergulhar no código e se aproximar bastante das soluções técnicas, desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades e melhoria do contexto de plataforma web na Stone. Atuará de forma "cross" em grandes projetos junto ao time de Customer Journey, ajudando a realizar o movimento de plataformização na companhia, além da adoção de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de web.

Responsabilidades

  • Lidar com problemas ambíguos e priorização desafiadora, equilibrando prazo e qualidade;
  • Ser influente em tomadas de decisões junto ao time em detalhes de soluções;

  • Buscar continuamente oportunidades para melhorar nossa plataforma web, processos e experiência do nosso cliente dev;

  • Experiência com typescript
  • Conhecimentos em padrões arquiteturais e design de código, adotando padrões de codificação consistentes e bem documentados;

  • Conhecimentos sobre estrutura de CI / CD, pipeline automatizado;

O que aumenta as suas chances

Overview

We are looking for a skilled Back-End Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.JS and a passion for creating efficient, scalable, and user-friendly applications. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and are eager to contribute to innovative projects, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum / Kanban).
  • Ability to write clean, scalable, and well-documented code.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI / CD tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Experience with microservices and RESTful API architecture.
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

  • Languages and Frameworks: Node.js, NestJS
  • Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB
  • Version Control: Git
  • Agile Methodologies: Scrum, Kanban
  • CI / CD Tools: Jenkins, Travis CI, or similar
  • Software Architecture: Microservices, RESTful APIs
  • Containers: Docker, Kubernetes

title: Senior Consultant Advisory Services
description:
Overview

Senior Consultant Advisory Services - Strategy

The Senior Consultant works collaboratively within a team of qualified Advisory consultants to deliver performance improvement to healthcare systems. This position will be primarily responsible for performing billable work for clients. The Senior Consultant actively leads and participates in engagement workstreams, determines client needs in terms of the engagement statement of work, leads data analyses, interprets results, develops potential solutions, and prepares deliverables and presentations for various audiences. It also supports risk identification and mitigation, manages workstream economics and project management, and assists in the implementation of recommended improvements.

The Senior Consultant participates in all aspects of an engagement including identifying issues, formulating hypotheses, planning and conducting interviews, overseeing analytics, developing recommendations, synthesizing information into presentations, and helping to implement change. The role involves daily management of project activities and workstream management and budgeting within the engagement team.

The Senior Consultant participates in Premier internal activities including practice development and approved educational opportunities throughout the year, and learning the various technologies Premier offers to its clients. The following expectations apply:

  • Maintain utilization targets for client billable projects
  • Create value through client interactions, data analytics and insights, and team participation on client projects
  • Contribute to the Advisory practice through activities that grow and enrich the Practice as a whole or individual Service Lines

Analytics Focused Roles

Analysts on the Analytics team will have expertise in Premier and PINC AI databases and methods of connecting datasets to create enriched analytics content. This role interacts with clients, internal product teams, and Advisory counterparts across service lines and is expected to build working relationships within the Premier/Client team. They will lead production and quality assurance of client analytics deliverables and provide data-driven insights and solutions. Additional responsibilities include:

  • Build and maintain dynamic and interactive data models based on Premier and client needs
  • Lead process standardization efforts
  • Lead efforts to standardize and automate client deliverables and internal tools
  • Troubleshoot Tableau workbooks, SQL scripts, Excel analyses, etc.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Responsibility #1 – 60%
    • Obtain data, execute analyses, interpret results, prepare verbal and graphic presentations, and perform quality assurance on deliverables; manage the workstream and ensure client satisfaction.
    • Assist in determining client needs through interviews and analysis; summarize findings and develop conclusions; draft recommendations for leadership review.
    • Execute project plans per engagement statements of work and client objectives.
    • Develop presentations and deliverables for client audiences communicating strategy and outcomes.
    • Generate revenue through analyses, reporting, and assisting with implementation of changes.
    • Participate in project management activities for the workstream and manage budget and expenses.
    • Identify and mitigate risks and issues with the project leadership team.
  2. Responsibility #2 – 20%
    • Participate in practice development activities for the Advisory Services Practice and/or Service Lines.
  3. Responsibility #3 – 10%
    • Learn Premier-based technologies and services.
  4. Responsibility #4 – 5%
    • Identify market opportunities on current engagements and share potential leads with managers.
    • Contribute to development of sales presentation deliverables using prescribed formats and technology.
    • Identify opportunities to improve profitability.
  5. Responsibility #5 – 5%
    • Complete all required training annually.

Required Qualifications

Work Experience: 4 or more years

Education: Bachelor’s (Required)

Preferred Qualifications

Skills:

  • Coordinate and deliver effective presentations to client audiences to communicate outcomes and strategy
  • Ability to conduct analyses and oversee and mentor others in client deliverables
  • Ability to relate to clients and team members collaboratively
  • Ability to lead work groups to successful outcomes

Analytics Focused Roles

Lean Process Improvement; Six Sigma Green/Black belt

Experience: Health Systems Finance, Operations, Operational or Strategic Consulting, Strategic Planning or Decision Support Analytics

Analytics Focused Roles

  • Experience analyzing complex healthcare data sets and developing visualizations and presentations to support data-driven recommendations
  • Experience with qualitative and quantitative data validation and analysis
  • Experience in new methodology development and strategic problem-solving

Education: Bachelor’s Degree, Master’s Degree

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Be adaptive and change priorities quickly; meet deadlines
  • Attention to detail
  • Operate computer programs and software
  • Communicate effectively with audiences in person and electronically
  • Day-to-day contact with others
  • Making independent decisions
  • Ability to work in a collaborative environment

Compensation and Benefits

Premier’s compensation philosophy is to ensure compensation is reasonable, equitable, and competitive. The salary range for this role is $90,000 - $150,000 and final compensation depends on market factors, education, and experience. Premier uses a wide-range salary structure to allow base salary flexibility within the range.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance
  • 401k retirement program
  • Paid time off
  • Participation in Premier’s employee incentive plans
  • Tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities

Premier at a glance:

  • Ranked #1 on Charlotte’s Healthiest Employers list for 2019, 2020, 2022, and 2023; 21st Healthiest Employer in America (2023)
  • Named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere Institute (16th year)

description:
Pessoa Especialista de Dados (Vaga Afirmativa para pessoas negras)

Job type: Full-time employee

Você quer trabalhar em um lugar que está transformando a educação pública do Brasil? Se imagina em um ambiente colaborativo , inovador e com um propósito que importa ? Quer fazer parte de um time que valoriza a diversidade , promove a inclusão e acredita na potência de cada pessoa?

Se respondeu sim para tudo isso, essa oportunidade é pra VOCÊ!

A Nova Escola é uma organização sem fins lucrativos e a marca mais reconhecida por educadoras e educadores da Educação Básica no Brasil. Nossa missão é fortalecer professores e professoras para transformar a educação pública e garantir que cada estudante desenvolva seu máximo potencial.

Somos mantidos pela Fundação Lemann e contamos com o apoio de parceiros como B3 Social, Microsoft, HP, Meta, Internet Society Foundation e Imaginable Futures . Essas parcerias nos ajudam e impulsionam nesse desafio de transformar a educação pública através dos educadores, promovendo ações que os apoiem a desenvolverem suas práticas, terem os melhores recursos e se informarem.

Sobre a área de Dados

A área de Dados da Nova Escola atua para organizar, analisar e disponibilizar dados que apoiem a tomada de decisões em toda a organização, com foco em aprimorar nossos processos e produtos e ampliar nosso impacto na Educação Básica. Nosso time é responsável por todo o ciclo de vida dos dados, desde a coleta e modelagem até a construção de análises, relatórios e dashboards, garantindo que diferentes áreas tenham acesso a informações confiáveis, úteis e acionáveis.

Trabalhamos em parceria com diferentes times, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e acessibilidade dos dados, e promovendo uma cultura orientada por evidências.

SUAS PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES SERÃO:

  • Trabalhar com bases de dados grandes e complexas, realizando a captura, manipulação e análise dessas informações
  • Conduzir todo o ciclo de análise de dados, da definição de requisitos à coleta, processamento, modelagem, visualização e apresentação de resultados
  • Criar e manter dashboards, relatórios e análises que apoiem a tomada de decisões e o acompanhamento dos objetivos estratégicos
  • Resolver problemas complexos e não triviais, como identificar padrões de comportamento de uso em produtos da Nova Escola, aplicando métodos analíticos avançados quando necessário
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e o monitoramento de métricas para gerar aprendizados e insights relevantes para a organização
  • Colaborar com diferentes áreas como Produto, Tecnologia, UX, Marketing, Conteúdo, Parcerias e Liderança para entender demandas, apoiar a disponibilização de dados, aprimorar análises existentes e contribuir na avaliação de resultados
  • Fazer recomendações baseadas em dados, como análises de comportamento de usuários, apoio na definição de metas organizacionais e OKRs dos squads, além do desdobramento e monitoramento dessas metas
  • Atuar como embaixador(a) da cultura orientada por dados, contribuindo para autonomia dos times e fortalecendo esse valor na Nova Escola

Para trabalhar na área de Dados, procuramos pessoas com:

  • Formação ou experiência consolidada em áreas quantitativas, com domínio de conceitos analíticos, estatísticos e computacionais
  • Experiência prática com análise de dados em contextos reais, com atuação em exploração de grandes bases, geração de insights e apoio à tomada de decisão
  • Domínio de SQL avançado, com capacidade de explorar bases complexas e responder questões analíticas de forma eficiente
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e ambientes em nuvem, especialmente AWS (por exemplo: Athena, S3, Glue, QuickSight)
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia em todo o ciclo de análise: desde o entendimento do problema até a entrega e comunicação dos resultados
  • Conhecimento para trabalhar com Python para análise de dados e automações
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (QuickSight, Looker, Power BI)
  • Clareza para traduzir dados em hipóteses, descobertas e recomendações compreensíveis por diferentes públicos.

Caso você cumpra a maioria, mas não todos os requisitos para a vaga, não deixe de se candidatar. Podemos conversar para te conhecer melhor e entender se conseguimos te apoiar nas aprendizagens necessárias!

Será um diferencial se você também tiver:

  • Maturidade analítica para escolher abordagens e ferramentas adequadas a cada contexto, sabendo equilibrar complexidade, tempo e impacto nas análises

Conheça a Nova Escola

A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil

Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.

Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. Nosso principal mantenedor é a Fundação Lemann e realizamos parcerias com diversas organizações como Google.org, Facebook, Fundação Itaú Social, Imaginable Futures, Governo Britânico, secretarias de educação e outras organizações que nos ajudam nesse desafio.

64% dos professores brasileiros utilizam nossos planos de aula todos os meses, além disso temos 3 milhões de visitantes únicos por mês em nossa plataforma e cerca de 1,8 milhões de seguidores em nossas redes sociais, o que nos permite conhecer bem nosso público.

Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!

Trabalhamos com

O Educador no centro: Para nós, a transformação acontece através das professoras e professores de escola pública. Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.

Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.

Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Juntos e Diversos: Para nós, a diversidade, a inclusão e os conhecimentos multidisciplinares são pilares fundamentais para as nossas práticas, tanto nas ações que desenvolvemos com/para os educadores do Brasil quanto em iniciativas internas. Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes trajetórias e pontos de vista se complementam e podem compartilhar um mesmo propósito. Pensamos juntos para pensar maior.

Atitude Responsável: Para nós, agir com responsabilidade é uma prática contínua, tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação. Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.

Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazer perguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimora nossos processos.

The Ascension Data Sciences Institute (ADSI) was created in July 2019 with the mission of supporting Ascension in achieving its Quadruple Aim with uniquely skilled, high-performing associates who develop analyses, models, and applications to enable Ascension in providing higher value healthcare and making strategic decisions. We recognize that the healthcare environment is a complex ecosystem of rapidly evolving clinical and economic practices that affect patient and provider experience and demands increasingly sophisticated and complex measurement. Our objective is for analytics and data science to play a critical and foundational role in the transformation of care delivery, quality and financial outcomes to enable our organization's competitive advantage.

We are hiring a Senior Analyst, Remote Patient Monitoring, within our Clinical Transformation team in ADSI, to support Ascension's goal to differentiate ourselves on patient quality and innovation. Clinical Transformation is a rapidly growing division of the company working to leverage health technologies that include AI, wearables, virtual care, personalized patient messaging, and remote patient monitoring - with our team leading analytic efforts around these programs. In this position, you will be responsible for supporting our growing space of remote patient monitoring programs, including new wearable device integrations and other device-based patient monitoring programs. You will be integrated within a multi-disciplinary group of analysts, data scientists, developers, engineers, and medical professionals, supporting the rapid development, monitoring, reporting, and scaling of these digital programs.

As an ideal candidate, you will bring strong technical expertise in data processing and reporting pipelines, as well as data exploration, visualization, and quality control. Experience in clinical settings and/or wearable or other technology integrations in healthcare are pluses. To be successful, you will need to have strong SQL skills, natural curiosity and eagerness to learn, and enjoy working in a high-performing team.

Core Responsibilities

  • Support remote patient monitoring program data requirements and quality assurance
  • Develop, build and maintain key performance indicators, in partnership with clinical leadership, including provider, patient, and business outcome metrics as well as implementation & expansion reporting
  • Support the evaluation of existing programs to ensure alignment with business and financial performance
  • Build and monitor data processing pipelines, working closely with data engineering and other technical teams to manage the data infrastructure needed to evaluate and scale programs
  • Build reporting dashboards that deliver on clinical and business stakeholder requirements, including documentation of data elements and metrics
  • Support ad hoc analytic requests and communicate findings to stakeholders to provide data-driven insights and guidance

Work Experience

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Strong SQL skills are required (Please note, the interview process will include a SQL assessment.)
  • Experience working with EHR, medical billing and coding, claims, and/or other healthcare data is preferred
  • Experience in clinical settings and/or wearable or other technology integrations in healthcare is desirable
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Tableau, Looker, and/or Salesforce is desirable

Opportunities

  • This role directly supports an innovative and research-focused team, there are opportunities to contribute to research design and scientific publication(s) on program effectiveness and patient outcomes

Qualifications

Education:

  • High school diploma/GED with 2 years of experience, or Associate's degree, or Bachelor's degree required.

Work Experience:

  • 3 years of experience preferred.

No additional preferences.
